source.command: python -m pytest tests/test_correction_frontier.py tests/test_publication.py -k "frontier or predecessor" -q

claims.claim: Established a pure read-only CorrectionFrontier surface that represents all PRIMARY findings as exact semantic lineage state without selection authority.
DELTA PASS advancement removes only the exact selected outstanding finding and preserves siblings, while invalid or already-resolved selection fails closed.
DELTA CHANGES_REQUIRED replaces only the selected finding with its own review findings while preserving siblings, and DELTA BLOCKED does not silently resolve the frontier.
Prospective publication consumes the correction frontier authority and refuses main mutation on semantic PASS when any outstanding finding remains.
Multi-finding predecessor lineage is no longer rejected merely for multiplicity; tests prove one selected finding can resolve while siblings remain outstanding and publication stays blocked.
Single-finding predecessor publication still succeeds after DELTA PASS and historical no-predecessor publication keeps its established behavior.
Preserved all REVIEW/REMEDIATION schemas, P3A predecessor shape, Unified State, Human Surface, Executor, verification, REPAIR, retry, and reroute contracts.
